results.title: The Tatopani border between Nepal and China reopened on Sunday, for three days only, after being closed since late August.
results.description:
The Tatopani border between Nepal and China reopened on Sunday, for three days only, after being closed since late August.
More than 45 containers of Dashain goods are waiting on the Chinese side, and traders want the crossing open for good. Is a festival window enough?
Full story: https://t.co/yqejLJQPwd
#Nepal #Dashain
